route_guardian_loader.label: PMP Current Route Guardian Loader v14

current_app.label: PMP Current v5 Phase 2 verification wrapper over v4 app

user_facing_rule: Only show PMP Current / PMP-CURRENT-1 as the app version.
home_screen_rule: Install pmp-app-current.html once. It is a stable map-driven door and should change as little as possible.
update_rule: Route Guardian v14 opens the current app only after the user presses Open Latest App. Current app v5 loads the existing v4 app and provides a Phase 2 Runtime Verification overlay with a copyable report. This does not prove hook validation, real app proof, current-clean, frozen, or best-in-world.
